messages:
Maria: quick sync — Acero customer story timeline. We need the interview recorded, a quote cleared by legal, and a short launch post + webinar mention. Target publish = Tue next week. can someone own the ops piece?

Kevin: I can own ops. booking interview w/ Acero CMO — earliest slot Fri 10am PT. do we want video or just audio + transcript?

Maria: audio + transcript is fine, grab short 20–25m slot. highlight performance win vs baseline + cost delta.

Ashley: I'll draft questions. focusing on: problem, why Redwood, perf/cost metrics, rollout experience, and one quick customer quote.

Liam: @kevin can you add the interview to the content checklist and share recorder link? use our standard template: <https://drive.redwood/internal/templates/case-interview>

Kevin: added checklist here: <https://drive.redwood/internal/checklists/acero-interview-1766>. recorder link in the doc.

Courtney: legal heads up — send the quote thru LegalBot for pre-clearance. we need an approved line by EOD Mon to hit Tue publish. LegalBot: please upload redlined quote in this thread when ready.

Maria: copy. Ashley, can you draft the one-sentence hero quote and a 2–3 sentence customer pull? rough first pass due by tomorrow.

Ashley: Draft incoming. quick draft now: "Redwood cut our inference latency by 3x and reduced per-token cost ~40%, letting us ship higher-value features without increasing infra spend." will refine.

Kevin: Pulled the key metric from Acero — they reported 68% reduction in tail latency and 38% cost savings on steady-state traffic. Ashley, use those numbers, but flag for legal to confirm phrasing.

Courtney: LegalBot: please check for competitive/benchmark wording (percentages are fine but avoid naming competitor models). Also confirm we have rights for customer name + quote.

LegalBot: received. Please submit quote text via the approval form: <https://legal.redwood/submit?case=acero-1766>. ETA review = 24–48h.

Maria: FYI — we want to mention the upcoming webinar (Apr 14) in the launch post. need to include webinar registration link and CTA to talk to sales. who's routing inbound leads?

Liam: Sales routing: we can create a custom HubSpot mid-funnel flow. Kevin, please add UTM tags and the "case-acero" lead source. We'll hook webhook to notify AE queue.

Kevin: added UTM + AE webhook. sample campaign params: ?utm_source=marketing&utm_campaign=acero_case&utm_medium=post&utm_term=case_acero

Ashley: posting language idea (short): "See how Acero cut inference tail latency 3x and lowered serving costs — read the case study + join our Apr 14 webinar to see the benchmark live."

Courtney: legal note — change "cut" to "reduced" in headline to be conservative. also remove "benchmark live" -> "live demo of optimizations".

Ashley: updated: "See how Acero reduced inference tail latency 3x and lowered serving costs — read the case study + join our Apr 14 webinar for a live demo of optimizations."

Maria: perfect. once LegalBot approves quote we can schedule the post + add webinar CTA. Kevin, can you coordinate with comms to schedule at 9am PT Tue?

Kevin: scheduled draft in Buffer for 9am PT Tue, awaiting legal sign-off. also assigned a Slack webhook to #sales for immediate lead ping on publish.

Liam: routing checklist: 1) HubSpot form mapping 2) AE webhook 3) Slack alert channel 4) track source in SFDC. I've created the ticket and assigned to @SalesOps.

Courtney: LegalBot: approved the customer quote with a minor edit — replaced "our inference latency" with "their inference latency" and confirmed rights to publish Acero name. uploaded redline to the form.

LegalBot: approval attached -> <https://legal.redwood/approvals/acero-1766/approved.pdf>

Maria: amazing — timeline holds. next steps: Ashley finalize post copy + publish assets (2 social cards, 1 blog hero image), Kevin flip publish to live at 9am Tue, Liam confirm sales routing is green, Courtney confirm legal artifact archived.

Ashley: final copy + images uploaded here: <https://drive.redwood/content/acero-final-assets>. I'll queue social copy variations after legal check.

Kevin: going to run a quick smoke test on the HubSpot flow tomorrow morning and confirm slack AE ping.

Liam: sales routing green — AE queue confirmed. ready to capture inbound demos.

Maria: thanks team :tada: locking this thread. I'll post the announce checklist once the post goes live.

Courtney: saved approval to the project folder, closing legal loop. :white_check_mark:
